svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 250 long from 29.2 x 1.8 chromoly tube; square and deburr both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check it slides in the reamed seat tube (29.4) and the post slides in it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stop slot, left side: 6 wide, from 90 to 226 up from the bottom end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chain drill 6 mm along a scribed line and file the sides straight;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its two ends are the stops, so file them square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top end: a 2 mm slit 26 long at the back, so the sleeve collar closes it;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: an M5 clearance hole (5.5) on the right side, 7 below the top, for the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Scribe the minimum insertion mark all round, 100 up from the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: goes into the seat tube slot-side left; the seat tube collar's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stop screw rides in the slot. 100 stays inside at the top stop.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: slot ends square; no burr inside the bore.
